filingText: This Amendment No. 1 to Form S-8 is filed solely to correct certain errors in the reoffer prospectus. The registration statement relates to the BitCompute Digital Inc. 2025 Equity Incentive Plan. The Reoffer Prospectus relates to up to 1,200,000 shares of common stock that may be offered for resale by the selling securityholders. The company will not receive proceeds from sales by the selling securityholders.
